title: TRAC: Efficient Diffusion Language Models for Machine Translation via Length-Aware Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.25643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine translation with large language models requires both high translation quality and low generation latency. Accelerating translation while preserving quality is therefore essential for practical deployment. Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate tokens at arbitrary target positions through iterative denoising, offering a new paradigm for parallel translation beyond sequential autoregressive decoding. However, existing methods still incur redundant computation: fixed target generation lengths waste computation on unused positions, while confidence-only commitment delays medium-confidence tokens whose predictions have largely stabilized. To address these issues, we propose TRAC, a training-free adaptive decoding method for diffusion machine translation. translated_title: TRAC：通过长度感知解码实现高效机器翻译的扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型进行机器翻译需要同时具备高翻译质量和低生成延迟。因此，在保持质量的同时加速翻译对实际部署至关重要。扩散大语言模型可以通过迭代去噪在任意目标位置生成token，为超越顺序自回归解码的并行翻译提供了新范式。然而，现有方法仍然存在冗余计算：固定的目标生成长度会在未使用的位置上浪费计算资源，而仅基于置信度的提交策略会延迟那些预测已基本稳定的中等置信度token。为解决这些问题，我们提出了TRAC，一种无需训练的扩散机器翻译自适应解码方法。TRAC利用源语言长度和翻译方向来自适应地调整目标生成长度，对于空输出或异常短的输出则保守地回退到最大长度。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的自适应解码方法TRAC，通过根据源语言长度和翻译方向动态调整目标生成长度、加速token提交，减少了扩散语言模型机器翻译中的冗余计算，在保持翻译质量的同时显著降低生成延迟。
en_tdlr: TRAC is a training-free adaptive decoding method for diffusion machine translation that adapts target generation length based on source length and translation direction, reducing redundant computation while preserving translation quality and lowering generation latency.
